summary: Z Squared Inc. entered a binding LOI on June 18, 2026, to acquire a majority membership interest in Paradox Data LLC, a digital infrastructure company. Consideration is issuance of $5,000,000 aggregate liquidation preference Series D Convertible Preferred Stock, no cash. Closing conditions include definitive documents, due diligence, technology/land/power vesting, consents, Nasdaq stockholder approval if needed, with a drop-dead date of July 31, 2026. The preferred stock is unregistered, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b). Watch for regulatory hurdles and definitive agreement terms.
